mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in labor demand (PAYEMS) predicts stronger employment growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when PAYEMS shows sustained upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 2.0%, it signals a shift toward tightening policy, but this may trigger expectations of future rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment environment, a rise in UNRATE above 5.5% signals unexpected weakness, prompting investors to seek value in equities, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when UNRATE rises above 5.5% in the low unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: Both the federal funds rate and unemployment rate rising simultaneously indicate coordinated policy easing and strong labor market conditions, fostering optimism that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals a robust economy, enhancing corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in CPIAUCSL below 237.5 (current 237.786) signals peak inflation concerns, prompting expectations of rate cuts and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when CPIAUCSL drops below 237.5 in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a drop in RSAFS below 446,477 (current value) indicates stabilization in demand, fostering confidence in economic recovery and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when RSAFS drops below 446,477 in the post-shock regime.
